title: Design System: Dwarf Eats Mountain Companion - Game-Inspired Preview

title.purpose: Selected upgrade names and compact priority titles.

body.purpose: Dense tooltip facts and explanatory content.

label.purpose: Fields, tiers, navigation, metadata, and state labels.

shadows.name: top-bar-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the compact masthead from the landscape.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts counters and the Prestige board from the frame.

shadows.name: node-lift

components.name: Primary Route Action
components.description: Yellow framed action used to enter the Prestige planner.
components.html: Open Prestige planner
components.css: .ds-primary-route { display: inline-flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 17px; border: 3px solid #f4f7ed; border-radius: 0; color: #142b43; background: #ffe33b; box-shadow: 4px 5px 9px rgb(8 26 41 / 42%); font: 700 0.5rem/1.45 "Silkscreen", monospace; letter-spacing: 0; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-primary-route-mark { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: #142b43; } .ds-primary-route:hover, .ds-primary-route:focus-visible { border-color: #f4f7ed; color: #142b43; background: #ffe33b; outline: 3px solid #ffe33b; outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 6px 7px 0 #102339; }

components.name: Interface Version Switch
components.description: Framed two-option switch that keeps Original available and identifies the opt-in preview.
components.css: .ds-mode-switch { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 2px solid #e8f4ef; background: #142b43; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #102339; } .ds-mode-switch button { min-height: 34px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: #b9d5df; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: 400 0.58rem/1.2 "Silkscreen", monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mode-switch button:hover, .ds-mode-switch button:focus-visible { color: #fff3ce; outline: 2px solid #e4a63d; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-mode-switch button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #142b43; background: #ffe33b; }

components.name: Resource Input
components.description: Compact numeric resource field inside the framed Prestige counter strip.
components.css: .ds-resource-field { display: flex; min-width: 180px; min-height: 66px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 9px 10px; border: 3px solid #e8f4ef; color: #b9d5df; background: #274e6a; font: 400 0.5rem/1.35 "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-resource-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 28px; padding: 2px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #ffe33b; border-radius: 0; color: #ffe33b; outline: 0; background: transparent; caret-color: #ffe33b; font: 700 0.92rem/1.2 "Silkscreen", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #102339; } .ds-resource-field input:focus, .ds-resource-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #f4f7ed; outline: 3px solid #ffe33b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Route
components.description: Current companion route with a yellow field and square pixel marker.
components.css: .ds-route { display: flex; min-height: 39px; gap: 7px; align-items: center; padding: 9px 8px; border: 2px solid #f4f7ed; border-radius: 0; color: #142b43; background: #ffe33b; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #102339; font: 400 0.63rem/1.25 "Silkscreen", monospace; text-decoration: none; } .ds-route > span { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 2px solid #142b43; background: #142b43; } .ds-route:hover, .ds-route:focus-visible { border-color: #e8f4ef; color: #f4f7ed; background: rgb(78 124 149 / 68%); outline: 3px solid #ffe33b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prestige Board
components.description: Dominant framed board with a tier label column and seven-column desktop grid.
components.css: .ds-prestige-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 98px minmax(0, 1fr); padding: 12px; border: 3px solid #e8f4ef; border-radius: 0; color: #f4f7ed; background: rgb(47 91 116 / 92%); box-shadow: 5px 6px 13px rgb(8 26 41 / 43%); font-family: "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-prestige-board header { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; padding: 12px 8px; } .ds-prestige-board header strong { color: #ffe33b; font-size: 0.72rem; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #102339; } .ds-prestige-board header span { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-prestige-board header small { color: #b9d5df; font-size: 0.47rem; } .ds-prestige-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(24px, 1fr)); gap: 9px; padding: 10px 8px 12px; } .ds-prestige-grid span { min-height: 44px; border: 3px solid #f4f7ed; background: #274e6a; box-shadow: 3px 4px 9px rgb(8 26 41 / 46%); }

components.name: Unowned Upgrade Node
components.description: Available but unowned node with white frame, cool blue field, cost badge, and empty pips.
components.css: .ds-node { position: relative; display: grid; width: 76px; min-height: 82px; place-items: center; padding: 5px 4px 19px; border: 3px solid #f4f7ed; border-radius: 0; color: #f4f7ed; background: #274e6a; box-shadow: 3px 4px 9px rgb(8 26 41 / 46%); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-node:hover, .ds-node:focus-visible { border-color: #ffe33b; outline: 0; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #102339, 0 0 0 5px #ffe33b, 0 7px 12px rgb(8 26 41 / 48%); } .ds-node[data-selected="true"] { border-color: #ffe33b; outline: 3px solid #77e7ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-node-icon { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 48px; place-items: center; } .ds-node-mark { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 5px solid currentcolor; box-shadow: 7px -7px 0 -3px currentcolor, -7px 7px 0 -3px currentcolor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-node-cost { position: absolute; top: -3px; right: -3px; display: grid; width: 22px; height: 22px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #142b43; color: #142b43; background: #f4f7ed; font-size: 0.54rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-node-pips { position: absolute; bottom: 7px; display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-node-pips i { width: 7px; height: 5px; background: #89aebe; }

components.name: Purchased Upgrade Node
components.description: Owned node with yellow frame, yellow cost badge, and filled rank pips.
components.css: .ds-node-purchased { position: relative; display: grid; width: 76px; min-height: 82px; place-items: center; padding: 5px 4px 19px; border: 3px solid #ffe33b; border-radius: 0; color: #ffe33b; background: #3f7896; box-shadow: 3px 4px 9px rgb(8 26 41 / 46%); cursor: pointer; font-family: "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-node-purchased:hover, .ds-node-purchased:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #77e7ff; outline-offset: 2px; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-purchased-icon { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 48px; place-items: center; } .ds-purchased-mark { width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 5px solid currentcolor; box-shadow: 7px -7px 0 -3px currentcolor, -7px 7px 0 -3px currentcolor; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-purchased-cost { position: absolute; top: -3px; right: -3px; display: grid; width: 22px; height: 22px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #142b43; color: #142b43; background: #ffe33b; font-size: 0.54rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-purchased-pips { position: absolute; bottom: 7px; display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-purchased-pips i { width: 7px; height: 5px; background: #ffe33b; } .ds-purchased-pips i.ds-empty { background: #89aebe; }

components.name: Locked Upgrade Node
components.description: Desaturated but focusable node whose accessible label carries the lock reason.
components.css: .ds-node-locked { display: grid; width: 76px; min-height: 82px; place-items: center; padding: 5px 4px 19px; border: 3px solid #91aeb9; border-radius: 0; color: #a9c0c8; background: #28485e; box-shadow: 3px 4px 9px rgb(8 26 41 / 38%); cursor: not-allowed; filter: saturate(0.35) brightness(0.82); font-family: "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-locked-mark { width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 4px solid currentcolor; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #28485e; } .ds-node-locked small { color: inherit; font-size: 0.42rem; } .ds-node-locked:hover, .ds-node-locked:focus-visible { border-color: #f4f7ed; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #102339, 0 0 0 5px #b9d5df, 0 7px 12px rgb(8 26 41 / 42%); }

components.css: .ds-inspection { width: min(330px, 100%); padding: 16px; border: 3px solid #e8f4ef; border-radius: 0; color: #f4f7ed; background: rgb(35 73 98 / 97%); box-shadow: 5px 6px 13px rgb(8 26 41 / 46%); font-family: "Silkscreen", monospace; } .ds-inspection-kicker, .ds-inspection small { color: #b9d5df; font-size: 0.49rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-inspection h3 { margin: 7px 0 0; color: #5cd7ff; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.3; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #102339; } .ds-inspection > strong { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: #ffe33b; font-size: 0.68rem; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #102339; } .ds-inspection hr { height: 3px; margin: 13px 0; border: 0; background: #e8f4ef; } .ds-inspection dl { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0 0 14px; } .ds-inspection dt { color: #ffe33b; font-size: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-inspection dd { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 0.6rem; line-height: 1.58; }

narrative.overview:
This system is the implemented visual language for the optional `game-inspired` standalone companion preview. It uses an original pixel mountain backdrop, icy slate-blue fields, hard pixel edges, compact game-menu hierarchy, white pixel lettering, yellow ownership and action states, and cyan inspection detail. The Prestige board is the dominant instrument; provenance and companion-only controls stay legible but secondary.

The preview is strictly opt-in under `data-visual-mode="game-inspired"`. The existing original/legacy interface remains the default and available mode; do not apply these preview tokens globally or describe the preview as a replacement. The product remains a fan-made companion, never an official game surface or a gameplay overlay.
keyCharacteristics: Cool layered panels over an original mountain atmosphere.
Yellow for ownership, maximum rank, active routes, and primary action.
Cyan and explicit framing keep selection distinct from ownership.
Dense seven-column desktop tree and purpose-built three-column mobile tree.
Visible provenance and uncertainty labels remain part of the interface.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Yellow communicates ownership or action; cyan and an explicit frame communicate selection. Never make those states indistinguishable.

rules.name: The Cool Field Rule
rules.body: Large surfaces stay within the icy slate family so the yellow state signal remains rare and immediate.

rules.name: The Pixel Voice Rule
rules.body: In preview mode, use Silkscreen across display, body, controls, and metadata; rely on hierarchy rather than a second decorative font.

rules.name: The Offset Legibility Rule
rules.body: White or yellow text over blue atmosphere may use a hard dark offset shadow, never a soft glow.

rules.name: The Board-First Rule
rules.body: Allocate the largest uninterrupted region to the upgrade grid; counters, provenance, and inspection detail support it rather than compete with it.

rules.name: The Hard Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and short dark offsets for structure; reserve diffuse shadow for separating the assembled command screen from the background.

rules.name: The Pixel Edge Rule
rules.body: Do not round preview panels or controls; every silhouette should read as a deliberate pixel-built rectangle.

dos: Do scope every game-inspired rule beneath `data-visual-mode="game-inspired"` and keep the original interface as the default available mode.
Do keep the Prestige board visually dominant and preserve its seven-column desktop and three-column mobile scan patterns.
Do combine color with frames, pips, labels, and lock explanations for ownership, selection, and availability.
Do keep local fallback marks usable when optional proprietary Prestige icons are absent.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences and preserve visible keyboard focus on every node, including locked nodes.
donts: Don't present the preview as an official game product, gameplay overlay, or screenshot replica.
Don't commit or depend on proprietary screenshots, sprites, fonts, audio, executables, saves, or raw extraction output.
Don't soften the preview into rounded cards, pills, or generic web-dashboard chrome.
Don't use yellow selection treatment alone; selection must remain distinct from purchased and maxed states.
Don't let companion-only details or unverified claims compete with verified upgrade information.
